sql: SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE net_profit_or_loss > 0 AND revenue >= 100000000 AND exchange_code != '' GROUP BY exchange_family

SELECT CASE WHEN auditor LIKE '%Ernst & Young%' OR auditor LIKE 'EY%' THEN 'EY' WHEN auditor LIKE '%KPMG%' THEN 'KPMG' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Pricewaterhouse%' OR auditor LIKE '%PwC%' THEN 'PwC' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Deloitte%' THEN 'Deloitte' WHEN auditor != '' THEN 'Other' END AS auditor_family, AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM finance WHERE dividend_per_share > 0 AND revenue > 0 AND auditor != '' GROUP BY auditor_family

SELECT CASE WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Healthcare%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN principal_activities != '' THEN 'Other' END AS activity_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE business_segments_num >= 3 AND principal_activities != '' GROUP BY activity_family

SELECT CASE WHEN net_profit_or_loss > 0 THEN 'profitable' ELSE 'loss_making' END AS profit_status, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' AND net_profit_or_loss IS NOT NULL AND net_profit_or_loss != 0 GROUP BY profit_status

SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, AVG(earnings_per_share) AS avg_eps FROM finance WHERE total_assets >= 1000000000 AND earnings_per_share IS NOT NULL AND exchange_code != '' GROUP BY exchange_family

SELECT CASE WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Healthcare%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN principal_activities != '' THEN 'Other' END AS activity_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE major_equity_changes = 'Yes' AND principal_activities != '' GROUP BY activity_family

SELECT CASE WHEN auditor LIKE '%Ernst & Young%' OR auditor LIKE 'EY%' THEN 'EY' WHEN auditor LIKE '%KPMG%' THEN 'KPMG' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Pricewaterhouse%' OR auditor LIKE '%PwC%' THEN 'PwC' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Deloitte%' THEN 'Deloitte' WHEN auditor != '' THEN 'Other' END AS auditor_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE cash_reserves >= 50000000 AND auditor != '' GROUP BY auditor_family

SELECT CASE WHEN dividend_per_share > 0 THEN 'pays_dividend' ELSE 'no_dividend' END AS dividend_status, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' AND dividend_per_share IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dividend_status

SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, AVG(total_debt) AS avg_debt FROM finance WHERE net_profit_or_loss > 0 AND total_debt IS NOT NULL AND exchange_code != '' GROUP BY exchange_family

SELECT CASE WHEN remuneration_policy LIKE '%Mixed%' THEN 'Mixed' ELSE 'Other' END AS pay_policy, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE revenue >= 100000000 AND remuneration_policy != '' GROUP BY pay_policy

SELECT CASE WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Healthcare%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN principal_activities != '' THEN 'Other' END AS activity_family, AVG(the_highest_ownership_stake) AS avg_top_stake FROM finance WHERE the_highest_ownership_stake BETWEEN 5 AND 60 AND principal_activities != '' GROUP BY activity_family

SELECT CASE WHEN auditor LIKE '%Ernst & Young%' OR auditor LIKE 'EY%' THEN 'EY' WHEN auditor LIKE '%KPMG%' THEN 'KPMG' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Pricewaterhouse%' OR auditor LIKE '%PwC%' THEN 'PwC' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Deloitte%' THEN 'Deloitte' WHEN auditor != '' THEN 'Other' END AS auditor_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE net_assets > 0 AND net_profit_or_loss > 0 AND auditor != '' GROUP BY auditor_family

SELECT CASE WHEN business_segments_num = 1 THEN 'single_segment' ELSE 'multi_segment' END AS segment_status, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' AND business_segments_num IS NOT NULL GROUP BY segment_status

SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE earnings_per_share > 0 AND dividend_per_share = 0 AND exchange_code != '' GROUP BY exchange_family

SELECT CASE WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Healthcare%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN principal_activities != '' THEN 'Other' END AS activity_family, AVG(cash_reserves) AS avg_cash FROM finance WHERE total_debt >= 100000000 AND cash_reserves IS NOT NULL AND principal_activities != '' GROUP BY activity_family

SELECT major_equity_changes, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE auditor LIKE '%KPMG%' OR auditor LIKE '%Ernst & Young%' OR auditor LIKE '%Pricewaterhouse%' OR auditor LIKE '%Deloitte%' GROUP BY major_equity_changes

SELECT CASE WHEN auditor LIKE '%Ernst & Young%' OR auditor LIKE 'EY%' THEN 'EY' WHEN auditor LIKE '%KPMG%' THEN 'KPMG' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Pricewaterhouse%' OR auditor LIKE '%PwC%' THEN 'PwC' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Deloitte%' THEN 'Deloitte' WHEN auditor != '' THEN 'Other' END AS auditor_family, AVG(business_segments_num) AS avg_segments FROM finance WHERE revenue BETWEEN 10000000 AND 5000000000 AND auditor != '' AND business_segments_num IS NOT NULL GROUP BY auditor_family

SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE net_profit_or_loss < 0 AND total_assets >= 100000000 AND exchange_code != '' GROUP BY exchange_family

SELECT CASE WHEN the_highest_ownership_stake >= 20 THEN 'concentrated' WHEN the_highest_ownership_stake IS NOT NULL THEN 'dispersed' END AS ownership_band, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' AND the_highest_ownership_stake IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ownership_band

SELECT CASE WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Healthcare%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN principal_activities != '' THEN 'Other' END AS activity_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE cash_reserves > total_debt AND principal_activities != '' AND cash_reserves IS NOT NULL AND total_debt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY activity_family
